title: Gin
notes: Gin's router, HTML renderer (html/template) and JSON helper in release mode, with its recovery middleware and no request logger.
details: Gin's router, its HTML rendering (LoadHTMLGlob and c.HTML, which is Go's html/template and does the escaping) and c.JSON, in release mode. The middleware is what gin.Default() sets up apart from the request logger: Recovery. Served by net/http's server with the router as its handler, as router.Run does. One process on the default Go scheduler (GOMAXPROCS is every core), built with go build and no flags beyond -mod=readonly. Go has no build-time prerendering, so /about is a template with no data, rendered on each request like the item page; the templates are parsed once when the server starts. No request logging.
